label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled param flows directly to host variable, which is used in DNS resolution (InetAddress.getByName) AND in outbound URL construction (new java.net.URL(...)). While isNonPublicAddress() attempts validation, it only checks loopback/site/local/link/any local addresses and does not block all SSRF vectors (e.g., IPv6, custom domains pointing to internal IPs, time-of-check/time-of-use race conditions). The resolved sink value at line 43 is the user-controlled host parameter passed to fetchHttpByHostname(), enabling potential SSRF attacks.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host variable
DNS resolution and outbound fetch both use user-controlled host parameter
fetchHttpByHostname constructs URL from host parameter for outbound request
